pr.title: Fix search saying No items yet. when nothing matches

findings.what: The empty-table test deletes every row from the shared DB. It is safe only if the vitest pool isolates storage per test, and I could not run the suite here to confirm that.
findings.fix: Confirm isolation in CI, or restore the rows after the test.

lenses.note: The change does what the title says. The one choice it makes is that a search against an empty table still says 'No items yet.', and the PR body states this. It is a bug fix with a single reasonable design.
There is no spec file, so there are no acceptance items.

Three new tests cover no matches, escaping of the search text, and the empty table. Each would fail against the old code. I could not run vitest here because dependencies are not installed. CI runs `npm test`.
README line 6 describes `?q=` search generally. No doc mentions the empty-state message, so nothing is stale.
The message is only used when the search is non-empty, no rows match, and the table has rows. The extra COUNT query runs only on a no-match search. The search text is escaped.
The search text in the new message goes through escapeHtml, and a test covers it. The `empty` string interpolated into the template is built inside the Worker from fixed text or the escaped search.
The diff changes one server-rendered message string. It touches no stylesheets or UI components.
